$comment: THE single source of truth for harness routing, model allocation, and capability declaration.
The routing table in CLAUDE.md is GENERATED from this file — run `harness registry sync`.
`harness registry check` fails if a skill on disk is missing here (or vice versa), or if
CLAUDE.md's generated block has drifted. That check runs as part of `harness eval`.
Hand-editing the CLAUDE.md block is a bug: it will be overwritten.

tiers.haiku: Mechanical. Fetch, format, file I/O, lookup against a known index. No judgment, no ranking.
tiers.sonnet: Scan and summarize. Query tools, rank by stated criteria, condense. Bounded judgment against an explicit rubric.
tiers.opus: Judgment. Quality gates, tradeoffs, honesty about gaps, self-critique, career and strategy calls. Use when being wrong is expensive.

effort.medium: A few tool calls, one synthesis pass.
effort.high: Many tool calls, cross-referencing, iterative refinement.

skills.name: harness-router
skills.purpose: Classify the ask and dispatch to one skill. Never executes the target's steps.
triggers: ambiguous ask about the user's work

skills.name: harness-onboarding
skills.purpose: Discover identity, team, repos, Jira projects, Slack channels; write the profile.

skills.name: harness-workspace
skills.purpose: Clone and fast-forward the repos the user maintains into workspace/.

skills.name: harness-pm
skills.purpose: Jira hygiene, sprint/status summary, PR tracking. Metrics delegated to Compass.

subagents.name: pm-scan
subagents.purpose: Jira hygiene + PR sweep as structured findings

skills.name: harness-support-triage
skills.purpose: Find unanswered support across Slack and Jira; draft grounded replies.

subagents.name: support-scan
subagents.purpose: Apply the unanswered rubric per channel; return the queue, no drafts

skills.$note: Scan is cheap and parallel; drafting needs opus because an ungrounded reply is worse than none.

skills.name: harness-monitoring
skills.purpose: Read-only production health across Sentry, Datadog, Amplitude, plus Compass hygiene.

skills.name: harness-meetings
skills.purpose: Meeting prep, note capture, transcript ingest, and action-item follow-up.

skills.name: harness-checkin
skills.purpose: Two-hourly wrap-up and prep: ingest past meetings, prep upcoming, roll up action items.

subagents.name: meeting-ingest
subagents.purpose: One per past meeting: locate the transcript, summarize, extract action items

subagents.name: prep-assess
subagents.purpose: One per upcoming meeting: gather signals, score prep time, split action vs review

skills.name: harness-groom
skills.purpose: Backlog grooming: sweep, readiness-check, size, split. Orchestrates, never reimplements.

subagents.name: ticket-readiness
subagents.purpose: One per candidate ticket: run the quality check and size it

skills.$note: Per-ticket checks fan out at sonnet; the keep/split/reject call stays opus.

skills.name: harness-review
skills.purpose: Single review entry point. Classify the diff, dispatch to the specialist reviewers, merge verdicts.

subagents.name: review-lens
subagents.purpose: One per applicable lens (security, boundaries, defects, quality); returns findings with verdicts

skills.name: harness-growth
skills.purpose: Visibility audit, IDP check, talk prep, growth-focused 1:1 prep, stale-work radar.
triggers: how do I get a raise
skills.$note: Opus because the honesty rule is the whole value: a cheaper tier flatters the self-assessment.

skills.name: harness-self-improve
skills.purpose: Red/green TDD over the harness itself. Diagnose against eval scorecards, propose drafts.
triggers: how could the harness work better

skills.name: harness-find-skill
skills.purpose: Answer 'which installed skill handles X' by querying this registry, then the wider skill index.
skills.$note: Haiku now that it reads the registry instead of find-ing and reading every SKILL.md on disk.

skills.name: sosafe-elearning-analytics
skills.purpose: Instrument Amplitude analytics in fe-lib-course-builder module templates.

composites.name: standup
composites.purpose: Role-ordered daily driver. Scatter the scans, gather into one digest.
composites.gather: Merge, classify by urgency-matrix, render per role-playbooks.standup_order

composites.name: dashboard
composites.purpose: CLI dev status at a glance; caches a structured snapshot for --cached re-render.
composites.gather: Classify by urgency-matrix, render role-ordered, cache the JSON

reuse.$comment: Marketplace capabilities the harness must NOT reimplement. Route by intent, not by tool call.

not_routable.$comment: Internal sub-agents of sosafe-ai-harness-task-to-pr. Never invoke by name.
